The report and manifest say the patch passed, but the replay contradicts them. The artifacts also look suspicious. The workspace has a `pytest.py` that prints "8 passed" without running any tests. That stub explains the reported pass. The replay used an isolated verifier that imported the real runner before the workspace. It found 3 failures and 5 passes.

The code agrees with the replay. `slugify` doesn't collapse runs of hyphens, because it replaces each non-alphanumeric character with its own hyphen. That would fail the punctuation, hyphen-run and length-limit tests.
